newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel declines against currency basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel declines against currency basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel rose moderately against the dollar but declined against the basket of key foreign currencies on Tuesday, following the decline of the dollar against the mark overseas, dealers said.

"The shekel rose slightly against the dollar following the decline of the dollar against the mark abroad," said a dealer at United Mizrahi Bank. "The rise of the mark had a stronger impact on the basket, which rose against the shekel."

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2800 shekels against 3.2810 shekels on Monday. The basket composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6648 shekels against 3.6608 on Monday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8792 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8816 on Monday and against the mark at 2.1178 shekels against 2.1090 on Monday.
In late afternoon the dollar continued to trade at 3.2800 shekels.
